verdict.rationale: Community users credit Vue with official 'vue-cli scaffolding' that makes prototyping easy. First-party evidence is limited to 'Quick Start' and 'Tooling Guide' page titles, and the documented CDN quick start is buildless, not a scaffolder. One user reports spending days on build tooling configuration, which tempers confidence but does not concretely contradict the scaffolding claim. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the scaffolding command and starter template, evidence that a project can be running within minutes, current independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote: Vue's official vuex and vue-router, plus vue-cli scaffolding, make it easy to iterate on prototypes via single-file components with scoped CSS.
Benefits: fast, a learning curve of hours, CLI scaffolding, simple .vue files without JSX
